notes: Repository exploration completed. Bevy is a cross-platform Rust game engine. The fix.patch modifies crates/bevy_render/src/view/mod.rs to fix MSAA rendering with multiple cameras. Project is fully Linux-compatible and can be built/tested in a standard Linux container with required system dependencies (libasound2-dev, libudev-dev, libwayland-dev, libxkbcommon-dev). No platform incompatibility blocking synthesis.
